_comment: Exact lines that name a retired UI driver WITHOUT teaching it — a ban that cannot name what it bans is unenforceable, and a learning rewritten to mention a tool it never used is a falsified record. A pin whose line disappears fails the gate, so this file cannot rot. See scripts/check-puppet-first.mjs.
